description: This repo dogfoods its own org-shared preset (default.json, consumed elsewhere as `github>FS-GG/.github`) instead of vanilla config:recommended, so the dist/dotnet pins it distributes are managed under the same semantics every product repo gets — dependency dashboard, semantic commits, and FS.GG.* feed/grouping/prerelease routing (review M9, #132).

This file used to add that 'the FS.GG.* rules are inert here today (no FS.GG.* PackageReferences)', and omitted the feed hostRules on that basis. The claim was false: .github/workflows/contract-coherence.yml pins FS.GG.SDD.Cli through the preset's annotation manager, which resolves from the private org feed. With no token here, every FS.GG.* lookup 401'd, Renovate could enumerate no versions, and no bump PR could ever open — so the validator pin froze at 0.2.1 across three minors (#127), was fixed by hand, and froze again at 0.5.0 across three more (#263). Only third-party bumps (nuget.org, no auth) were ever observed. A PackageReference is not the only kind of FS.GG.* dependency a repo can have. scripts/check-pin-coherence.py now gates both halves — the token below, and the pins it enables.

hostRules.description: read:packages auth for the private org GitHub Packages NuGet feed (FS.GG.* are not on nuget.org). Lives in this repo's own config — NOT the shared preset — because Renovate does not substitute {{ secrets }} inside presets pulled via extends. Value = org-level Mend App Secret FSGG_PACKAGES_READ_TOKEN. Identical to the block every product repo carries; .github was the one repo that authored the preset and never adopted its own requirement (#263).
